caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden chair with a high, ornate backrest featuring a central splat and two curved uprights. The chair is colored in various shades of brown, indicating a wood grain texture throughout the frame, legs, and backrest. The seat of the chair is a darker color, appearing almost black or dark gray, and has a subtle texture that differentiates it from the wood. The legs of the chair are cabriole style, with curved, outward-facing shapes and decorative knee sections. The background of the drawing is a plain, untextured beige or off-white color, with no additional objects or decorations present. At the bottom left of the image, there is a small, handwritten signature that reads "Louis Annin."
title: Side Chair
